newsitem.title: USA: Pioneer still backs $2.70-3.10 EPS range.
newsitem.headline: Pioneer still backs $2.70-3.10 EPS range.

text.p: Seed company Pioneer Hi-Bred International Inc said Thursday it still expects earnings for fiscal 1997 to be in the range of $2.70 to $3.10 a share, compared with $2.68 earned a year ago.

"We expect a strong 1997 with EPS in line with analysts' predications of $2.70 to $3.10 for the whole year," Carrol Bolen, vice president, legal and government affairs, said in a presentation at the Piper Jaffray investor conference here.
Pioneer had given the same earnings estimate range in April. Fiscal 1997 ends in August.
The First Call consensus for fiscal 1997 is $3.01 a share.
